localTips.title: Move your phone plan to a lower-cost brand
localTips.why: The big three carriers own cheaper brands on the same networks, and their plans often cost much less for the same data.
tips: Compare your plan with Fizz, Public Mobile, Lucky Mobile, Koodo, Freedom or Virgin Plus; you can keep your number.
Call your internet provider’s retention department and ask for the new-customer price, or switch.
If you pay off a phone through your plan, check when it ends and move to a cheaper bring-your-own-phone plan.

localTips.title: Use home energy rebates before winter
localTips.why: Heating is the biggest energy cost in most Canadian homes, and provinces and utilities pay for many upgrades.
tips: Check your province’s and gas utility’s rebate programs (for example Enbridge or FortisBC) for insulation, smart thermostats and heat pumps.
Seal drafts around doors and windows and turn the heat down 2–3°C at night and when you are out.
If your utility offers equal monthly billing, use it to avoid winter bill shocks (it does not lower the total).
